correctness.rationale: The exact cross-product Pascal formula for the normalized sextuple was independently derived, its four forbidden substitutions were proved injective and pairwise distinct, and their character sums and zero counts were checked algebraically, including the exceptional \(b=-1\) case. Group orbit-stabilizer factors convert normalized counts to each fixed line. The unrestricted theorem is symbolic, while exact enumerations over 9, 27, and 81 elements plus an independent enumeration of all 12600 hexagons over the nine-element field provide separate finite corroboration. No unproved finite extrapolation enters the proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete incidence-fiber invariant of smooth conics is calculated in the sole odd exceptional characteristic left by earlier restricted formulas. Exceptional square identities alter the arithmetic counts, and the theorem simultaneously determines every tangent/secant/exterior fiber and the sharp first finite-field threshold for rational Pascal surjectivity. This is not a parameter substitution in an existing characteristic-uniform formula.
